title: Mechanism ledger export: the raw evidence table
headline_insight: The full ledger exports 287 tested mechanisms -- 130 confirmed, 126 null, 31 not testable -- each with its effect size, p-value, and corpus pointer.
what_it_means: This is the raw evidence table behind the survival scoreboard: every named mechanism with its verdict and a pointer to the exact corpus and sample that produced it. NBA's back-to-back rest penalty, for instance, confirmed at an effect of -1.73 (p 0.005645490426098632) on a 4,732-game corpus.
how_to_read: Each row is one mechanism run; the bucket field collapses many verdict labels (CONFIRMED_LOCAL, NULL, REJECT, NOT_TESTABLE, and so on) into confirmed / null / not_testable.
why_it_matters: Publishing the effect, p-value, and corpus for every mechanism including the nulls is what lets an outside reader re-derive any claim instead of trusting a summary number.
caveat: as_of is the recorded run_ts and is null for runs that predate run_ts stamping, so many rows carry no timestamp and a single mechanism can appear multiple times across corpora.
as_of: run_ts-stamped rows through 2026-07-10; older rows unstamped
